title: Ox Alpha Free 是什么模型？
excerpt: 问与答 - @boringfish - opencode 上看到了一个限时 免费的模型 Ox Alpha Free 有 v 友试用过吗
content_html:
A new stealth model is live on OpenRouter.

Ox Alpha is an unreleased frontier model running under a codename. It runs on dedicated capacity on OpenRouter, and it is free for everyone while the lab behind it readies it for public release.

Ox Alpha is free on OpenRouter through Monday, August 24.

------

今天收到邮件，OpenRouter 也上了。
